paper.title: Regret Lower Bound and Optimal Algorithm in Dueling Bandit Problem

settings.name_in_paper: K-armed dueling bandit problem under the Condorcet assumption (RMED1)
unmapped: Preference matrix has a Condorcet winner (arm 1 with mu_{1,j} > 1/2 for all j)
Regret per round is (Delta_{1,i}+Delta_{1,j})/2 when pair (i,j) is compared
settings.definition_quote: At each round $t=1,2,\dots,T$, the forecaster selects a pair of arms $(l(t), m(t)) \in [K]^2$, then receives a relative feedback $\myX{l(t)}{m(t)}(t) \sim \Bernoulli(\muij{l(t)}{m(t)})$ ... Throughout this paper, we will assume that the preference matrix has a Condorcet winner

settings.name_in_paper: K-armed dueling bandit problem under the Condorcet assumption (RMED2FH, known horizon)
unmapped: Preference matrix has a Condorcet winner
Regret per round is (Delta_{1,i}+Delta_{1,j})/2 when pair (i,j) is compared
settings.definition_quote: Note that, unlike RMED1 and RMED2, RMED2FH requires the number of rounds $T$ beforehand to conduct the initial $\myalpha \log{\log{T}}$ draws of each pair.

settings.name_in_paper: K-armed dueling bandit, Condorcet model M_C (lower bound)
unmapped: Model class: preference matrices with a Condorcet winner
settings.definition_quote: The set of preference matrices which have a Condorcet winner is denoted by $\mcondor$.

settings.name_in_paper: K-armed dueling bandit, total order model M_o (lower bound)
unmapped: Model class: preference matrices inducing a total order (subset of Condorcet model); learner knows the total-order structure
settings.definition_quote: We also define the set of preference matrices satisfying the total order by $\morder\subset \mcondor$

conditions: strongly consistent algorithm for model M_C (regret o(T^a) for all a>0)
bound on E[sum_{j in O_i} d(mu_ij,1/2) N_ij(T)] for each suboptimal arm i

source.label: lem:drawlower
source.quote: (i) Let an arm $i \in \nonwinner$ and preference matrix $\Mat \in \mcondor$ be arbitrary. Given any strongly consistent algorithm for model $\mcondor$, we have \Expect\left\{\sum_{j \in \SetO{i}} d(\muij{i}{j}, 1/2) N_{i,j}(T) \right\} \geq (1 - o(1)) \log{T}

results.notes: Lower bound on KL-weighted comparison counts, not regret.

conditions: strongly consistent algorithm for model M_o
bound on E[sum_{j in O_i} d(mu_ij,1/2) N_ij(T)] for each suboptimal arm i

source.label: lem:drawlower
source.quote: (ii) Furthermore, inequality \eqref{ineq:drawlower} holds for any $\Mat \in \morder$ given any strongly consistent algorithm for $\morder$.

symbols.C_duel: sum over i != 1 of min_{j in O_i} (Delta_{1,i}+Delta_{1,j})/(2 d(mu_{i,j},1/2)), O_i = {j : mu_{i,j} < 1/2}, Delta_{1,i}=mu_{1,i}-1/2

conditions: strongly consistent algorithm for model M_C

source.label: thm:regretlower
source.quote: (i) Let the preference matrix $\Mat \in \mcondor$ be arbitrary. For any strongly consistent algorithm for model $\mcondor$, \liminf_{T \rightarrow \infty} \frac{\Expect[\Regret(T)]}{\log{T}} \geq \sum_{i \in \nonwinner} \min_{j \in \SetO{i}} \frac{\myDelta{1}{i} + \myDelta{1}{j}}{2 d(\muij{i}{j}, 1/2)} holds.

results.notes: Regret defined through preference means, hence pseudo_regret; comparator is the Condorcet winner pair (1,1).

symbols.C_duel: sum over i != 1 of min_{j in O_i} (Delta_{1,i}+Delta_{1,j})/(2 d(mu_{i,j},1/2))

conditions: strongly consistent algorithm for model M_o (total order)

source.label: thm:regretlower
source.quote: (ii) Furthermore, inequality \eqref{ineq:regretlower} holds for any $\Mat \in \morder$ given any strongly consistent algorithm for $\morder$.

results.notes: Same lower bound under total-order model.

bound.expression: sum_subopt(((1 + delta_s)*log(T) + f_K)*Delta_1i/(2*d_i1)) + K**2 + K/delta_s**2 + K*exp(A*K - f_K)
bound.expression_latex: \sum_{i \in \nonwinner} \frac{((1 + \mysmalldelta) \log{T} + f(K) ) \myDelta{1}{i}}{2 d(\muij{i}{1}, 1/2)} + O(K^2) + O\left(\frac{K}{\mysmalldelta^2}\right) + O(K \e^{\CoefA K-f(K)})

symbols.f_K: non-negative function f(K) input to RMED
symbols.A: instance-dependent constant A({mu_ij}) independent of T

conditions: preference matrix has a Condorcet winner

source.label: thm:verone
source.quote: For any sufficiently small $\mysmalldelta > 0$, the regret of RMED1 is bounded as: \Expect[\Regret(T)] \leq \sum_{i \in \nonwinner} \frac{((1 + \mysmalldelta) \log{T} + f(K) ) \myDelta{1}{i}}{2 d(\muij{i}{1}, 1/2)} + O(K^2) + O\left(\frac{K}{\mysmalldelta^2}\right) + O(K \e^{\CoefA K-f(K)})

results.notes: Leading term is explicit; lower-order terms are O(.). Notation O used for whole expression.

conditions: preference matrix has a Condorcet winner

source.label: thm:verone
source.quote: Therefore, by letting $\mysmalldelta = \log^{-1/3}{T}$ and choosing an $f(K) = c K^{1+\mysmallepsilon}$ for arbitrary $c,\mysmallepsilon>0$, we obtain \Expect[\Regret(T)] \leq \sum_{i \in \nonwinner} \frac{ \myDelta{1}{i} \log{T}}{2 d(\muij{i}{1}, 1/2)} + O(K^{2+\mysmallepsilon}) + O(K\log^{2/3}{T}).

results.notes: Matches lower bound when b*(i)=1 for all i.

bound.expression: sum_subopt((Delta_1i + Delta_1b)*(1 + delta_s)*log(T)/(2*d_ib)) + alpha_r*K**2*log(log(T)) + K*exp(A*K - f_K) + K*log(T)/log(log(T)) + K/delta_s**2 + K*f_K
bound.expression_latex: \sum_{i \in \nonwinner} \frac{(\myDelta{1}{i} + \myDelta{1}{\bsi}) ((1 + \mysmalldelta) \log{T})}{2d(\muij{i}{\bsi}, 1/2)} + O(\myalpha K^2 \log{\log{T}}) + O(K \e^{\CoefA K - f(K)}) + O\left( \frac{K \log{T}}{\log{\log{T}}} \right) + O\left(\frac{K}{\mysmalldelta^2}\right) + O\left(Kf(K)\right)

symbols.Delta_1b: Delta_{1,b*(i)} with b*(i) = argmin_{j in O_i} (Delta_{1,i}+Delta_{1,j})/d(mu_{i,j},1/2)

conditions: preference matrix has a Condorcet winner

source.label: thm:vertwo
source.quote: For any sufficiently small $\mysmalldelta>0$, the regret of RMED2FH is bounded as: \Expect[\Regret(T)] \leq \sum_{i \in \nonwinner} \frac{(\myDelta{1}{i} + \myDelta{1}{\bsi}) ((1 + \mysmalldelta) \log{T})}{2d(\muij{i}{\bsi}, 1/2)} + O(\myalpha K^2 \log{\log{T}}) + O(K \e^{\CoefA K - f(K)}) + O\left( \frac{K \log{T}}{\log{\log{T}}} \right) + O\left(\frac{K}{\mysmalldelta^2}\right) + O\left(Kf(K)\right)

results.notes: Leading term explicit; others in O(.).

bound.expression: sum_subopt((Delta_1i + Delta_1b)*log(T)/(2*d_ib)) + alpha_r*K**2*log(log(T)) + K*log(T)/log(log(T)) + K**(2 + eps_alg)

conditions: preference matrix has a Condorcet winner

source.label: thm:vertwo
source.quote: By setting $\mysmalldelta = O((\log{T})^{-1/3})$ and choosing an $f(K) = c K^{1+\mysmallepsilon}$ ($c,\mysmallepsilon>0$) we obtain \Expect[\Regret(T)] \leq \sum_{i \in \nonwinner} \frac{(\myDelta{1}{i} + \myDelta{1}{\bsi}) \log{T}}{2d(\muij{i}{\bsi}, 1/2)} + O(\myalpha K^2 \log{\log{T}}) + O\left( \frac{K  \log{T}}{\log{\log{T}}} \right)+ O\left( K^{2+\mysmallepsilon}\right).

results.notes: Leading term equals C_duel*log(T), matching the lower bound asymptotically.
